record_line: Yesterday: 0-4 on the top plays · Season: 36-147

entries.headline: Brandon Lowe stayed in the yard
entries.story: Brandon Lowe went 0-for-3 with 1 BB against Blade Tidwell and the San Francisco Giants. No real scare on the HR front.

entries.headline: Kyle Stowers came close
entries.story: Kyle Stowers went 1-for-3 against Michael Wacha and the Kansas City Royals. Closest call was a double in the 3rd: "Kyle Stowers doubles (24) on a sharp line drive to center fielder Kyle Isbel." The power showed up; the carry did not.
